title: Atlas: administration
description: Atlas domains, their vocabularies and export of the verified dataset.

domains.title: Atlas domains
domains.intro: Each of the cooperative's fields of work (such as beekeeping or gardening) has its own label vocabulary, kept by the experts. An archived domain keeps its photos and labels but takes no new ones.
domains.name: Name

export.title: Dataset export
export.disabled: Export is off. The server operator can turn it on with ATLAS_EXPORT_ENABLED=true in the .env file.
export.intro: Approved photos of one domain whose authors agreed to export, with their marks in COCO or YOLO format. A downloaded file cannot be withdrawn: photos revoked later are only flagged in the list below.
export.stepUp: A dataset export needs a fresh sign-in.

errors.export_disabled: Export is off in the server configuration.
errors.rate_limited: The daily export limit has been reached.
errors.failed: The export could not be created.
